speed_bin_convention: Left closed/right open, final edge positive infinity; original sum-reduction LSQ speed
bin_scope: All speeds for three radar strata times four original future-GT groups; seven individual bins only for no_radar/all
population: Original future-valid AND CRN-uncovered owner<0; preserve ALL original source support
primary_population: Exactly original photo reason_code==0; all six scores share every such point, regardless of FB availability or predicted endpoint OOB
extension_population: Exactly original photo reason_code==4, low current-zero texture; separately report only four defined scores; no ZNCC zero fill; no mixing with primary
other_population: Original reason_code 1/2/3 remains physically counted, with no flow scoring
point_weight: 1/number of ALL original points in each object; never re-normalize to any radar/speed/uncovered/photo/flow/pose/FB subset
denominator: ALL original future-valid objects per horizon/group, including fully covered and all score/pose/FB-missing objects

feature_definitions.flow_score_px: norm(uZero_current + Fcp(uZero_current) - uZero_past) - norm(uD_current + Fcp(uD_current) - uD_past)
feature_definitions.broken_flow_score_px: Same residual difference using independent F(current, np.roll(past, width//2, axis=1)); original candidate past UV is NOT shifted
feature_definitions.score_broken: Original frozen broken ZNCC residual_zero - residual_D
feature_definitions.lsq_speed_xy_mps: norm(sum_h(h*D_h_xy)/sum_h(h*h)), nominal original four horizons, old NumPy sum-reduction bytes/bins

primary_auc.scores: All named primary or extension scores at fixed positive directions; identical population within each branch
primary_auc.zero: Excluded only from binary AUC, separately counted
primary_auc.undefined: null if either weighted class absent

secondary_auc.population: Intersection of scoring branch with the EXISTING reference_valid pose mask, same support for all scores; no new pose extraction
secondary_auc.extension: All reason-4 references missing by existing pose contract; report zero available points, all missing counts and null AUCs
secondary_auc.privilege: Historical GT only supplies this diagnostic target; not a deployable feature or mathematical upper bound

FB.scope: True forward and reverse flow only, separately at zero and D current addresses
FB.domain: Closed original image rectangle x in [0,1599], y in [0,899]; exact final pixel centers are valid
FB.missing: Predicted endpoint OOB makes FB undefined/NaN; it does not make the primary or extension score unavailable
FB.summaries: Original-point-weighted conditional mean FB residual in px, endpoint OOB point fraction and original-weight fraction, full-original-denominator FUTURE physical gain/cost by available/OOB
FB.forbidden: No confidence/visibility claim, no FB threshold and no score filtering

physical_ledger: Full original future physical gain/cost retained in reason0/reason4/other partition, plus the two true-flow FB-availability partitions within each scoring branch
limitations: Training-internal D-seen train512 / 256 scenes; no unseen-scene generalization claim
Frozen RAFT shares the original image evidence and adds an external learned prior; not statistically independent truth
Original virtual material points are not certified visible surfaces
Broken flow is a destructive negative control, not known-transform equivariance or flow-accuracy evaluation
Pixel residuals and descriptive AUC do not establish model, motion, routing or occupancy improvement
Past consistency and future D benefit are distinct labels; four horizons reuse the same past evidence and are not independent
Primary and low-texture extension have different supports and must not be pooled

frozen_inference_settings.broken_candidate_past_addresses: unchanged, matching original ZNCC broken convention
frozen_inference_settings.fb: true forward+true reverse only; continuous; no filtering/threshold
frozen_inference_settings.sampling: bilinear closed original pixel-center domain; exact last pixel allowed; no extrapolation
frozen_inference_settings.extension: original lowtexture reason4 exactly; no original ZNCC scores available
frozen_inference_settings.other_reasons: remain missing; original five reason codes retained
frozen_inference_settings.out_of_bounds_predicted_endpoint: keep primary/extension residual; only FB becomes missing

extraction_protocol_analysis_contract.future_target: original D-versus-zero future XY displacement benefit, all four horizons
extraction_protocol_analysis_contract.past_target: existing history-GT actual-camera-time benefit only on original photo-valid and pose-valid shared support; unavailable on reason4
extraction_protocol_analysis_contract.physical_denominators: all original future-valid objects, including unobserved and covered points
extraction_protocol_analysis_contract.individual_speed_bin_scope: only no_radar/all; exact previous fixed bins
extraction_protocol_analysis_contract.FB: conditional continuous summaries and available/OOB physical accounting, never gate or select score population
extraction_protocol_analysis_contract.interpretation: train512 internal evidence discrimination, not measured flow accuracy, causal sensor information or model gain

runtime_amendment.reason: Observed shared-GPU anchors 2 through 6 take approximately 8.2 seconds per anchor; estimated 512-anchor duration approximately 70 minutes exceeds the previous 3600-second cap. Resource observation only, not scientific scores.
